role: The HUD's item records (a scene's state/item_table.json, RenderStateProbe's records by item id) read once a process and scene, converted by the caller's function into flat records, and looked up by id and damage (lane/rlasync): raster_hand.c's per-view parse of the 11 MB file put 2.5 million blocks into each env's heap.
gpu: itemtab_get: a process-wide list of tables built under a lock (the renderer's, never the tick's), allocated from the process heap with the env heap off
notes: An engine file, not one of pipeline.mk's PL_RENDER files, so the views' private copies of playview.so share one table. raster_hand_item_lookup's choice (the record whose dmg is meta, else the id's first) is kept: 291,171 lookups compared with the jval-tree lookup, 0 differ.
